criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 10 January 2027 (180 days after the 14 July 2026 Prospectus date).

Identifies that the $20,000,000 Pemberton Marine Ltd class action in the board minutes is omitted from the Prospectus legal proceedings and risk factors, creating disclosure liability, and recommends adding disclosure.
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies the undisclosed $2,500,000 interest-free loan to director Idris Fairbairn that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (180 days) and a date (10 January 2027), with days remaining from 8 June 2026 (216 days).
Notes that 10 January 2027 is a Sunday and identifies the next Business Day, 11 January 2027, as the first trading opportunity.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
